endorsements.name: Tomer Peled
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-3676
endorsements.description:
A security issue was discovered in Kubernetes where a user
 that can create pods on Windows nodes may be able to escalate to admin 
privileges on those nodes. Kubernetes clusters are only affected if they
 include Windows nodes.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.8)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.

endorsements.name: Tomer Peled
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-5528
endorsements.description: A security issue was discovered in Kubernetes where a user that can create pods and persistent volumes on Windows nodes may be able to escalate to admin privileges on those nodes. Kubernetes clusters are only affected if they are using an in-tree storage plugin for Windows nodes.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.2)

endorsements.name: Tomer Peled
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-66335
endorsements.description: Apache Doris MCP Server versions earlier than 0.6.1 are affected by an improper neutralization flaw in query context handling that may allow execution of unintended SQL statements and bypass of intended query validation and access restrictions through the MCP query execution interface. Version 0.6.1 and later are not affected.
